question: In 1 km linear race, P beats Q by 120 metres or 30 sec. What is the time taken by P to cover the race?
solution:
**Given:- **

Track length = 1 km

**Formula used:- **

Distance = Speed × Time

**Calculation:-**

"P" beats "Q" by 120 m or 30 sec,

which means "Q" covers 120 m in 30 sec

Speed of "Q" = 120/30 = 4 m/s

Time to cover 1000 m = 1000/4 = 250 sec

"P" beats "Q" by 30 sec means "P" reach 30 sec early

Time taken by "P" to complete the race = 250 – 30 = 220 sec

**∴ The time " P " takes to complete the race is__ 220__ sec.**
